name: pond
title: Pond
description: Search, save, and organize your local Pond library from Raycast.
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: search-saves
commands.title: Search Saves
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Search your library by keywords or meaning, then open, tag, file, or trash a save.

commands.name: search-media
commands.title: Search Media
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Browse the images and videos in your library as a grid.

preferences.name: columns
preferences.title: Columns
preferences.description: How many saves fit in each row.

commands.name: search-tags
commands.title: Search Tags
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Find a tag and see the saves that carry it.

commands.name: search-folders
commands.title: Search Folders
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Find a folder and see the saves inside it.

commands.name: search-views
commands.title: Search Saved Views
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Open a saved view or smart folder from your library.

commands.name: random-save
commands.title: Open Random Save
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Open a random save from your library in Pond.

commands.name: save-url
commands.title: Save URL

commands.name: save-clipboard
commands.title: Save Clipboard URL

commands.name: switch-library
commands.title: Switch Library
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Switch Pond to one of your recent libraries.

commands.name: open-library
commands.title: Open Library
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Bring Pond to the front with your active library.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Pond
commands.description: Show recent saves and capture progress in the menu bar.

tools.name: search-saves
tools.title: Search Saves
tools.description: Find saves by keywords, by meaning, or by source, tag, folder, and date. Returns short summaries with Pond links and a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get-save
tools.title: Get Save
tools.description: Read one save's details, including its tags, folders, note, and rating.

tools.name: read-save-text
tools.title: Read Save Text
tools.description: Read the text Pond extracted from a save: its caption, text in images, transcript, and note.

tools.name: list-tags
tools.title: List Tags
tools.description: List the tags in the active library, most used first.

tools.name: list-folders
tools.title: List Folders
tools.description: List the folders in the active library with their full paths and IDs.

tools.name: list-libraries
tools.title: List Libraries
tools.description: List recent libraries with their exact paths and which one is active.

tools.name: get-library-info
tools.title: Get Library Info
tools.description: Read the active library's name, path, save counts, and capture queue.

tools.name: save-url
tools.title: Save URL
tools.description: Save a web URL to the active library, with optional tags and a folder.

tools.name: edit-tags
tools.title: Edit Tags
tools.description: Add tags to saves or remove tags from them.

tools.name: add-to-folder
tools.title: Add to Folder
tools.description: Add saves to a folder, or take them out of one.

tools.name: trash-saves
tools.title: Move to Trash
tools.description: Move saves to the Trash. You can restore them in Pond.

tools.name: switch-library
tools.title: Switch Library
tools.description: Switch Pond to a recent library using its exact path from List Libraries.

tools.name: open-save
tools.title: Open Save
tools.description: Open a save in Pond, or open its original web page.

tools.name: open-library
tools.title: Open Library
tools.description: Bring Pond to the front with its active library.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Local API Token
preferences.description: In Pond, open Settings, then Preferences, and choose Copy Token under Raycast.
preferences.placeholder: Copy from Pond Settings → Preferences → Raycast

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Local API URL
preferences.description: Change this only if you changed the port in Pond.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
